lessons.label: Intro
lessons.title: How Tagalog sentences work
lessons.summary: The big ideas, explained in plain English before any rules

lessons.label: Intro
lessons.title: Tagalog and the Filipino people
lessons.summary: Where the language comes from, how it became the national language, and the people who speak it

lessons.title: The Tagalog alphabet
lessons.summary: Letters, vowels, the ng and r sounds, and how borrowed words are spelled

lessons.title: Syllables and stress
lessons.summary: How to break words into beats, and why the stressed syllable matters

lessons.title: Greetings and common expressions
lessons.summary: Pô and opô, greetings through the day, how are you, five ways to say excuse me, and everyday expressions

lessons.title: The articles si and ang
lessons.summary: The little words that go before the subject, and how to show more than one

lessons.title: Sentence formation
lessons.summary: The two basic word orders, and how to turn one into the other

lessons.title: Personal and demonstrative pronouns
lessons.summary: I, we, you, he, she, they, and this and that

lessons.title: Words that link and describe
lessons.summary: The ligatures -ng, -g and na that join two words when one describes the other

lessons.title: Words that show possession
lessons.summary: Ni and ng, the possessive pronouns (ákin, ko…), and nitó, niyán, niyón

lessons.title: Asking questions
lessons.summary: The 14 question words, their plural forms, short forms like 'yan and 'to, and everyday questions

lessons.title: The question word ba
lessons.summary: Ba, the spoken question mark: where it goes, ba'y, the particles na, pa, din, daw and nga, and bang

lessons.title: Making comparisons
lessons.summary: As … as (kasíng-, magkasíng-), like (parého, gáya), more than (mas … káysa), very (nápaka-) and most (pinaká-)

lessons.title: Using may and mayroón
lessons.summary: Saying there is / there are and has / have with may and mayroón, and saying none with walâ

lessons.title: Numbers
lessons.summary: Counting in Tagalog and Spanish, ordinals (first, second…), fractions, and prices

lessons.title: -Um- and mag- verb forms
lessons.summary: Doer-focused verbs: making the -um- and mag- forms in every tense, and the two sentence patterns

lessons.title: -In- verb forms
lessons.summary: Passive verbs that put the spotlight on the thing acted upon: alisín, basáhin, kánin…

lessons.title: The articles ang and ng
lessons.summary: When to use ang (the main character) and when to use ng (the other characters), and their plurals

lessons.title: Pseudo verbs: dápat, gustó and others
lessons.summary: Must, can, need, like and don't like: dápat, maáarì, puwéde, kailángan, ibig, gustó and áyaw

lessons.title: Ma- and Maka- verb forms
lessons.summary: Ma- and maka- verbs that show ability, and stressed má- and maká- verbs for accidental actions

lessons.title: Magíng: to be or to become
lessons.summary: Using magíng before a noun or adjective to talk about changing from one state to another

lessons.title: Magkaroón: to have
lessons.summary: Magkaroón ng + noun and the short magka- + noun, in the past, present and future

lessons.title: Expressing thoughts and actions
lessons.summary: Saying what you think with tila, sa akalà, sa palagáy and isip, and saying where you go and what you did with pumuntá and other verbs

lessons.title: Expressing emotions
lessons.summary: Two words for love (mahál and ibig) and when to use each, and saying what you like with gustó and ibig

lessons.title: Who, which and that
lessons.summary: Using the ligatures -ng, -g and na to say the child who is eating, the house which was burned, the food that was cooked

lessons.title: Saying please
lessons.summary: Paki- and maki- request verbs, softening with ngâ and namán, and asking with maáarì bang

lessons.title: Saán and násaán: where
lessons.summary: Saán for where an action happens, násaán for where a person or thing is, and how to answer each

lessons.title: The preposition sa
lessons.summary: One small word for in, to, from, for, on, into, over, through and at; position words; gáling, mulâ, búhat and hanggáng

lessons.title: Para sa and para kay: for and to
lessons.summary: Spotting the indirect object: para sa and para kay (for), sa and kay (to), and kina for two or more names

lessons.title: Telling time
lessons.summary: Anóng oras na? The hours with ika-, their Spanish equivalents, and words for past, present and future

lessons.title: The word when in Tagalog
lessons.summary: Kailán in questions, nang / noóng for the past, kung / kapág (pag) for the present and future, and kung + question words

lessons.title: Verb roots
lessons.summary: The root is the basic form of a verb: add affixes to make verbs and adjectives, or put ang before it to make a noun

lessons.title: Forming nouns
lessons.summary: Put ang, ng or sa in front of a verb or adjective and it becomes a noun: the one who, the thing that, what is

lessons.title: I- verb forms
lessons.summary: The prefix i- makes passive verbs for doing something for someone or using something: isúlat, ilutò, ibigáy

lessons.title: -An verb forms
lessons.summary: The suffix -an (or -han): places like aklátan, and passive verbs like basáhan, lagyán and buksán

lessons.title: Adverbs
lessons.summary: Words that say how, where, when and how much: nang paupô, dáhan-dáhan, díto, saanmán, lagí, kung mínsan, kauntî…

lessons.title: Conjunctions and interjections
lessons.summary: Joining words such as at, o, péro, kung, nang, kundî, dáhil sa, sapagká't, and emotion words such as Abá!, Aráy!, Nakú! and Sáyang!

lessons.title: Magpa- and pa- + -in verb forms
lessons.summary: Verbs for having something done by someone else: magpakáin, pakaínin (feed someone), magpabása, pabasáhin (order someone to read)

lessons.title: Expressing Disagreement, Agreement or Doubt
lessons.summary: Saying no, don't and I don't like (hindî, huwág, ayaw), yes and that's true (oô, siyangâ, totoó, talagá), and maybe (maráhil, tíla, sigúro, bakâ, maáarì)

lessons.title: Forming nouns from verbs
lessons.summary: Gerunds: turn -um-, mag-, -in, paki-, ma- and -an verbs into nouns such as pag-alís (leaving), pagbása (reading) and paghuhúgas (washing)

lessons.title: Forming participles using naka-
lessons.summary: Naka- + a noun or verb root describes how someone is: nakaupô (seated), nakatayô (standing), nakasapatos (in shoes), nakakotse (in a car)

lessons.title: Noun affixes
lessons.summary: Affixes that make new nouns: -an (aklátan), ka-…-an (kaligayáhan), mag- (mag-asawa), mang- (manggagamot), pag-, sang-, tag- (tag-ulán), taga- (tagaturò), tala-…-an (talátinígan), plus ways to make nouns plural

lessons.title: Formation of adjectives
lessons.summary: Turning root words into describing words with ma-, ka-, kay-, maka-, pang-/pam-/pan-, mapag- and pala-

lessons.title: Plural forms of verbs
lessons.summary: Plural verbs for plural doers and receivers: magsi- (magsikáin), magsipag- (magsipaglakád), pag- + -in (paglutuín) and pag- + -an (paghuhugasán)

lessons.title: Contractions
lessons.summary: Everyday shortened words: téka (wait!), téna (let's go!), ayóko (I don't like), pénge (give me), 'dî, 'nó, ikámo and more

lessons.title: Colors
lessons.summary: Basic colors (pulá, asúl, diláw, bérde…), dark colors (asúl na asúl), light colors with murá, shades (mapúla-púla, pulahán) and colors named after things (bérdeng mansánas, gintô)

lessons.label: A1
lessons.title: Foods
lessons.summary: Market words for food: vegetables (talóng, kamátis, sibúyas…), fish and shellfish (bangús, sugpô, alamáng), noodles (bíhon, cantón), meats (karné ng baka, karné ng baboy), poultry (manók, itlóg) and spices (patís, toyò, sukà)

lessons.label: A2
lessons.title: Cooking terms
lessons.summary: Twenty kitchen verbs with the book's example sentences (ihurnó, batihín, pakuluín, pritúhin, igisá…) and the popular Filipino dishes: adóbo, sinigáng, lechón, lumpiá, hálo-halò and more

lessons.label: A3
lessons.title: Tagalog idioms
lessons.summary: Thirty everyday idioms with their literal and real meanings and the book's example sentences: bukás ang palád (generous), magsúnog ng kílay (study hard), mahabá ang dilá (gossiper), pagputî ng uwák (never), saling-pusà and more

lessons.label: A4
lessons.title: Everyday Tagalog expressions
lessons.summary: Ready-made phrases for directions, children, time, speaking Tagalog, introductions, dressing up, parties, goodbyes, the market, kitchen, dining room and living room

lessons.label: A5
lessons.title: Conversations: meeting people, directions, the bank, a meeting, the market
lessons.summary: Five real-life conversations with the book's translations: welcoming a visitor and making introductions, asking directions, changing money at a bank, running a club meeting, and shopping at the market and supermarket

lessons.label: A6
lessons.title: Conversations: the mall, mealtime, visiting the sick, school, a vacation
lessons.summary: Five more conversations with the book's translations: a family day at the mall, breakfast, lunch and supper at home, visiting a sick friend, the first day back at school, and a family beach trip

lessons.label: A7
lessons.title: Book vocabulary list: more words
lessons.summary: The 493 words in the book's Tagalog–English Vocabulary List (pages 208 to 213) that are not taught in any lesson, as flashcards

lessons.label: R1
lessons.title: Review: Parts I and II – sentences, passives and possessives
lessons.summary: The book's first review exercises: using words in sentences, active to passive, a Bible-story translation, possessive phrases (my mother, John's plan, cat's eye) and choosing the right response

lessons.label: R2
lessons.title: Review: Parts III and IV – pronouns, describing words and ang, ng, sa
lessons.summary: The book's review exercises Parts III and IV: filling in pronouns, missing words and describing words, answering ba questions, translating sentences, and choosing ang, ng or sa

lessons.label: R3
lessons.title: Review: Parts V and VI – verbs, saan/nasaan, time and ma-/maka-
lessons.summary: The book's review exercises on -um-, mag- and -in verbs, saan and nasaan, time words and telling the time, and ma- and maka- verbs, with the book's answers

lessons.label: R4
lessons.title: Review: Parts VII and VIII – particles, comparisons, can and should, causatives and passives
lessons.summary: The book's review exercises on word order with ba and other particles, comparing and intensifying adjectives, can/should sentences, magpa- and pa- + -in verbs, plural adjectives, verbs and adjectives used as nouns, and passive sentences, with the book's answers
